selected_experiment.question: For new substitution-argument identities, which runtime operation originally constructed the argument object: substitute, shift, WHNF, instantiation, normalization, another method, or source/untracked input?
selected_experiment.instrumentation: tag successfully returned Kernel.make objects with the currently active kernel-method parent in a WeakMap; read the tag only when an exact newArgument cache-key event occurs

classification_rule.single_generator_dominant: same provenance category exceeds 50% of sampled newArgument events in both cases
classification_rule.stable_small_generator_basis: same dominant provenance in both cases and top-3 provenance coverage >= 80% in both, but no single category exceeds 50%

post_result_policy.if_single_generator_dominant: move to a prospective representation quotient at that generator boundary rather than broad substitution cache changes
post_result_policy.if_stable_small_generator_basis: split by generator provenance and target the largest branch prospectively
post_result_policy.if_distributed_generation: compile obstruction against generator-local explanation and reclose

claim_boundary: Diagnostic object-origin tagging only. Provenance labels are not semantic equality and do not change construction, sharing, substitution, or cache admission.
